is_anopheles.evidence: Studies field-collected Anopheles gambiae sensu stricto across 12 sites in West Africa (page 1221, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study focuses on molecular forms (M and S forms and M/S hybrids) using ribosomal RNA PCR-RFLP and a 400K Affymetrix SNP array to investigate speciation. Target insecticide resistance markers (such as Vgsc L995F/S or Ace-1 G280S) are only discussed in passing in the discussion (page 1229) with references to prior literature, but were not genotyped or reported.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts/frequencies for any target insecticide-resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected using indoor pyrethrum spray collections and light traps in The Gambia, Senegal, Guinea-Bissau, and Republic of Guinea between 2007 and 2009 (pages 1222–1223).

is_primary_study.evidence: The study presents primary field collection and molecular form/SNP microarray analysis data.

sub_country_location.evidence: 12 specific sampling localities are reported with geographic coordinates (e.g. Njabakunda 13°33'N, 15°54'W; Madina Djikoye 13°37'N, 16°18'W; Sedhiou 12°43'N, 15°4'W) in Table 1 and pages 1222–1223.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between April 2007 and August 2009 (pages 1222–1224).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary entomological collections conducted specifically for this speciation study across four countries.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not investigate insecticide resistance markers, and the supplementary data only cover microarray quality control and contrast difference distributions.

assessment.summary: This study analyzes incipient speciation and breakdown of reproductive isolation between the M and S molecular forms of Anopheles gambiae s.s. across 12 sites in The Gambia, Senegal, Guinea-Bissau, and Guinea. Although 3499 mosquitoes were genotyped for M/S molecular form and pooled samples were analyzed by high-density SNP microarrays, no target insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype or report any of the target insecticide resistance markers.
